parsed.rationale: Both participating records in this cluster have is_test=true and reside in Shared/AppServices/Tests/AppServicesTests/ReviewRequestServiceTests.swift. The two methods — ReviewRequestServiceTests.shouldRequestReviewAtThreshold (line 90) and ReviewRequestServiceTests.didRequestReviewResetsState (line 153) — are distinct test cases that happen to share structural shape (Jaccard 0.769), but each exercises a different behavioural contract of ReviewRequestService: threshold-based review prompting versus post-review state reset.
